success.description: You cut strange and worrisome sigils into the target's skin, dealing normal damage. The target gains a temporary insanity with the Chaos or Trauma trait.

chaosStar.description: All cultists in close range (including the attacker) suffer 1 wound.

conservative.requirements: Engaged with target, equipped with a shuriken dagger or similar weapon (preferably a sacrificial Special). If at least two other cultists are engaged with the target, reduce difficulty modifier to {Dc} 1.

success.description: The attacker infuses his assault with the power granted by his abhorrent faith. The attack inflicts critical damage.
As above, and the target is afflicted by a temporary insanity with the Chaos or Trauma trait until the end of the current act.

chaosStar.description: All cultists in close range (including the attacker) suffer 1 wound.

reckless.requirements: Used By: Cult Follower, Cult Leader. Engaged with target. Special: If the attacker is within close range of at least three other cultists, reduce the difficulty modifier to {Dc} 1.
